interpretation.label: sleep_head_change_reaches_e3_ranking__rollout_yes__curiosity_undetermined
interpretation.combination_rule: outcome PASS iff >= 2 ready seeds AND C1 (SLEEP_BOTH top1_diff_rate minus NULL >= 0.05 on >= 2 ready seeds on which SLEEP_BOTH is determinate, i.e. >= MIN_TICKS paired finite ticks). C2/C3 attribute the route, each pass/fail/undetermined and spelled out in the label; C4 (x4 extrapolation), C5 (whole-organism sleep) and C6 (norm-matched random direction) are recorded context. Ready = yoke_exact AND sleep_moved_head AND REINIT_BOTH determinate and >= positive-control floor AND n_ticks.

preconditions.name: seed42::yoke_exact
preconditions.description: NULL twin (identical weights) must reproduce A bit-exactly: max of top1/sel diff rate, TV max and ran-mismatch count
preconditions.control: NULL twin -- identical state_dict, identical per-step RNG

preconditions.name: seed42::sleep_moved_head
preconditions.description: relative L2 change of the world head across the sleep cycle

preconditions.name: seed42::positive_control_reach
preconditions.description: a freshly-initialised world head must re-rank >= 10% of E3 ticks, else the instrument cannot register reach
preconditions.control: REINIT_BOTH twin (both routes carry a random head); certifies the top1_diff_rate instrument for BOTH routes jointly

preconditions.name: seed42::n_ticks
preconditions.description: paired fresh-select E3 ticks (A vs NULL)

preconditions.name: seed42::curiosity_route_live
preconditions.description: fraction of A's E3 ticks with non-zero 314a novelty deviation range; scoped to C3 ONLY
preconditions.control: A twin, live 314a channel; certifies the curiosity route readout only

preconditions.name: seed42::curiosity_route_positive_control
preconditions.description: a random head swapped into ONLY the 314a summary read must re-rank >= 10% of ticks; scoped to C3 ONLY. If unmet, the 314a route has no top-1 authority at this curiosity weight and C3 cannot discriminate (rank_discordance still recorded)
preconditions.control: REINIT_CURIOSITY_ONLY twin; certifies the curiosity route readout only
